number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant's liability is decided by the Court; the co-accused was already acquitted below.

accused_gender.reason: Appellant referred to as 'he' and as the husband.

accused_religion.reason: No religion stated; a 'divine retreat' does not name one.

accused_occupation.quote: The appellant was a police constable at the time of marriage
accused_occupation.reason: Former police constable who resigned and went abroad.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Correctly framed as a defence claim.

statutory_provisions.quote: charge-sheet was laid against both the accused persons under Sections 498A/302 read with Section 34 IPC

weapon.quote: strangulated her by using a plastic rope and then hanged her ... by using a saree
weapon.reason: Alleged instruments correctly given with the Court's caveat.

evidence_type.quote: Admittedly there is no eye-witness to the incident.
evidence_type.reason: Circumstantial, medical and recovery evidence correctly listed.

confession.reason: No confession; the accused denied the charge.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Alleged affair and plot; the Court found them not established.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: the letters ... do not reveal anguished outbursts of a wife
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Letters, remittances and the cordial marriage were relied on by the Court.

trial_court_outcome.quote: acquitted both of them of the charge under Section 498A but held the appellant guilty of the offence of murder

high_court_outcome.quote: The appellant failed to secure his acquittal before the High Court
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court sustained the conviction; appeal no. 668/2008 is given on p.5.

final_outcome.quote: The appeal is thus allowed and the conviction and sentence ... set aside.
final_outcome.reason: Appeal allowed; benefit of doubt given.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Should include the alleged extra-marital motive, avoid stating defence claims as fact, and note only PW6 gave an inquest statement while PW1 lodged the FIR.
neutral_facts.quote: His statement, as recorded on the date of the inquest i.e. 20.9.2000
neutral_facts.reason: Omits the prosecution motive, states defence claims as fact, and wrongly says three witnesses gave inquest statements.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment.

physical_harm.quote: pressure abrasion on the neck and fracture of the greater horn of hyoid bone

premeditation_planning.quote: the appellant plotted to eliminate the deceased
premeditation_planning.reason: Alleged plot; the Court did not find it proved.

motive.quote: is also not borne out definitively by the materials on record
motive.reason: Alleged motive correctly marked as not established.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the essence of their testimony qua the incident ... has remained the same

witness_credibility.quote: we are unable to lend our concurrence to these reasonings
witness_credibility.reason: Matches the Court's assessment of PWs, DW1 and the doctor.

post_offence_conduct.quote: the conduct and the movements of the appellant prior thereto had been somewhat unusual and disoriented

custody_duration.reason: The arrest date is given; the total duration is not.

trial_duration.reason: The trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.quote: Basant R., Raghenth Basant, M. F. Philip ... G. Prakash, Jishnu M. L.

investigation_status.quote: charge-sheet was laid against both the accused persons

procedural_irregularity.quote: there is no reason forthcoming for re-examining these witnesses after almost four years

legal_principle_applied.quote: suspicion however grave, it cannot take the place of proof

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Citations match those given in the judgment.

other_sentence_order.quote: The appellant be released from the jail forthwith if he is not required in any other case.
